description: Baseline strict-2D SOS-RPA prescription (q-averaged strict-2D RPA correlation energy).

in_plane_kgrid.per_system_override_rule: Converge the in-plane mesh before averaging over q.
in_plane_kgrid.rationale: The q-average is only meaningful once the in-plane sampling is converged.

vacuum.per_system_override_rule: Converge the vacuum thickness for the 2D slab.
vacuum.rationale: Insufficient vacuum breaks the 2D Ewald decoupling.
